title: Career roadmap · Business Analyst
summary: A Business Analyst connects business needs with data, processes and technology by identifying problems, gathering requirements, analysing performance and recommending practical solutions.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a standard 3-year BBA. If a 4-year honours/research variant is available, use the additional year for advanced analytics, SQL, business-process modelling, internships and a major analytics project.

about.label: Course alignment
about.text: Business Analyst is directly aligned with the BBA – Business Analytics pathway.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build business fundamentals, Excel, SQL, statistics, dashboards, requirements gathering and process-analysis skills; complete internships and practical projects.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Specialise in business analytics, product analytics, process improvement, BI, consulting, finance analytics or digital transformation.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress toward Senior Business Analyst, Lead Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Analytics Consultant or Product Manager.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine business strategy, analytics, AI-assisted decision-making, process optimisation and stakeholder leadership.

Career progression
Alternative routes:
Progression depends on domain expertise, analytical capability, communication and company structure.
PhD routes
Relevant research areas include:
A PhD is primarily useful for research, university teaching, advanced consulting or specialised analytical research.

The long-term goal should be to move from reporting and requirements gathering toward business decision ownership. AI will automate parts of reporting, documentation and routine analysis, so senior Business Analysts will need stronger skills in problem framing, process redesign, experimentation, strategic thinking, stakeholder management and AI-assisted decision-making.
